subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Do maintainers approve raising the per-agent SQLite schema from v11 to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics and publishing the new memory-host event normalization API as a supported Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: Repository policy requires explicit acceptance for SQLite schema-version advances, and a new public Plugin SDK entrypoint establishes a compatibility commitment that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve both persistent contracts
options.body: Record acceptance of the v12 agent migration and the public SDK export, then require a rebased final-head upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the SDK surface internal
options.body: Redesign the Memory Core migration path so normalization is not added to the public Plugin SDK, while separately deciding whether the v12 agent schema remains justified.

options.title: Split the ACP schema work
options.body: Land the audit and Memory Core journal migration separately and defer the v12 ACP storage change until its schema contract has dedicated approval.

recommendation.title: Approve both persistent contracts
recommendation.body: Record acceptance of the v12 agent migration and the public SDK export, then require a rebased final-head upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite flip is the closest established ownership trail for the neighboring per-agent storage and migration contract.
